f_ir.name: loss_margin_rank_blend_tanh_logsumexp_advantage
f_ir.intuition: Computes a smooth margin-based pairwise hinge loss weighted by the maximum absolute advantage, using tanh smoothing and logsumexp aggregation.
f_ir.pseudocode:
lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
adv_w = batch['advantage_w']
adv_l = batch['advantage_l']
adv_max = ops.maximum(adv_w, adv_l)
margin = alpha * (lpw - lpl)
smooth_margin = tanh(clamp(margin, -10, 10))
hinge = relu(1 - smooth_margin)
loss = hinge * abs(adv_max) * weight
max_loss = max(loss)
loss_scalar = log(sum(exp(loss - max_loss))) + max_loss
final_loss = loss_scalar.mean()
f_ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']
    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', lpw.new_ones(lpw.shape))
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    adv_max = ops.maximum(adv_w, adv_l)
    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    scaled_margin = ops.mul(alpha, margin)
    clamped_margin = ops.clamp(scaled_margin, -10.0, 10.0)
    smooth_margin = ops.tanh(clamped_margin)
    hinge = ops.relu(ops.sub(ops.ones_like(smooth_margin), smooth_margin))
    loss = ops.mul(hinge, ops.abs(adv_max))
    loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    max_loss = ops.maximum(loss, ops.zeros_like(loss))
    lse = ops.log(ops.sum(ops.exp(ops.sub(loss, max_loss))))
    loss_scalar = ops.add(lse, max_loss)
    return loss_scalar.mean()
